2609.17515.title: What Breaks Under Pruning in Smart Homes, and When? Evaluating LLM Degradation Across Architectures and Task Complexity
2609.17515.paper_summary: Pruning can reduce the deployment cost of large language models (LLMs), but its impact on context-grounded tool calling remains poorly understood. We systematically study pruning-induced degradation in smart-home tool calling across four LLMs spanning dense Transformer, dense hybrid, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, together with depth, width, hybrid, and expert pruning methods. After post-pruning supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we evaluate more than 19,500 instances from three smart-home datasets. Beyond aggregate task accuracy, we characterize degradation along two dimensions: action components (i.e., operation, device, argument, and value) and task complexity. Our results show that dense models have narrow safe pruning regions followed by sharp degradation, while MoE models tolerate substantially more pruning. Pruning degrades grounded specificity before schema-level intent, and aggressive dense pruning can induce systematic over-refusal. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating pruning beyond aggregate accuracy when selecting pruned LLMs for reliable tool execution.
2609.17515.paper_summary_zh: 修剪可以降低大型語言模型（LLMs）的部署成本，但其對於上下文驅動的工具調用的影響仍然不甚了解。<lb/>我們系統性地研究了在四種 LLM 中，智能家居工具調用中由修剪引起的降級，這些 LLM 包括密集型 Transformer、密集型混合和專家混合（MoE）架構，以及深度、寬度、混合和專家修剪方法。<lb/>在後修剪的監督微調（SFT）之後，我們評估了來自三個智能家居數據集的19,500多個實例。<lb/>除了整體任務準確率外，我們還從兩個維度特徵化降級：行動組件（即操作、設備、參數和數值）和任務複雜性。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，密集模型有狹窄的安全修剪區域，隨後出現急劇降級，而 MoE 模型則能容忍更多的修剪。<lb/>修剪在模式層意圖之前降低了基於上下文的特異性，而激進的密集修剪可能會導致系統性的過度拒絕。<lb/>這些發現突顯了在選擇經過修剪的 LLM 以實現可靠的工具執行時，評估修剪超越整體準確率的重要性。
